fact_text: A developer said a project sold at launch loses value during the 5-6 years it takes to finish if informal settlements take over nearby land, because crime, load-shedding and electricity theft then rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The FY26 budget announced removal of a levy called FED on property, imposed in 2024; the developers' association said it had been withdrawn before but kept being charged.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The FY26 budget restricted non-filers from buying property, according to the developers' association speaker.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The developers' association asked that non-filers be allowed to buy property, with FBR later sending them a welcome letter to bring them into the tax net once the purchase appears in FBR records.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: A guest said FY26 rules are also tough on filers, and warned that heavy enforcement on businesses could push the business community to move capital out of Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The developer said construction cost depends on cement, steel rebar, marble, tiles and bathroom sanitaryware, with dollar parity and inflation strongly affecting them, and that 72 allied industries serve construction.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The developer said construction cost rose sharply after the 2020 COVID period; a building that cost about PKR 34,000 per sq ft to build before that period has risen far more since.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The developer said the 72 allied construction industries were running about 30% below normal output in June 2025 because construction in Karachi had slowed sharply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: King's Builders & Developers said it has worked in Pakistan since 1977 and has built projects in several locations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: King's Grand, the developer's project on about 20 acres in Scheme 33 Karachi, plans around 15 towers; the developer said seven towers are complete and sold.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The developer expected phase one of King's Grand to be completed within six to eight months, with possession handed over in stages two to four months apart once electricity connection is ready.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: King's Grand offers pedal (cycling) facilities, a swimming pool, a mosque and parks, with double-basement parking and ground-floor parking only for guests.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: King's Grand's 3-bedroom lounge units are about 1,250 sq ft, according to the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: King's Grand's 4-bedroom drawing-TV lounge units are about 2,000 sq ft, according to the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: According to the developer, King's Grand 3-bedroom lounge units sold for about PKR 62 lakh when first sold five to six years before 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: According to the developer, King's Grand 3-bedroom drawing-TV lounge units sold for about PKR 79 lakh when first sold five to six years before 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: According to the developer, King's Grand 4-bedroom drawing-TV lounge units, about 2,000 sq ft, sold for about PKR 94 lakh when first sold five to six years before 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: The developer offered instalment plans of 3, 4 or 5 years on towers under construction, and said buyers paying cash for ready units get a discount.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)

fact_text: A guest said Karachi offers better price appreciation over 2 to 5 years than any other Pakistani city, but buyers should check a builder's credibility, past on-time delivery and any land or allottee fraud before booking.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Karachi’s Property Crisis: Slums, Costs & Stalled Projects | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-29)
